title: Clock HUD
description: Show the your system time in game.
body:
Keep track of time without leaving the game. Simple System Clock adds a clean, lightweight, and non-intrusive system clock to your HUD.

No more alt-tabbing to check the time!

### Key Features:
- ✅ Zero Impact: Extremely lightweight; won’t affect your FPS.
- ✅ Clean UI: Minimalist design that blends perfectly with the vanilla Minecraft aesthetic.
- ✅ Real-time: Syncs perfectly with your system clock.
